title: Promissory note text everywhere
description: Every promissory note shown or offered now reads "<Faction>'s <Note>" with its printed card text (clamped with More / Less where space is tight), through one helper (promissoryNoteMeta). Support for the Throne in the trade desk names its issuer, shows the card text and the current holder. Raw ids (antivirus:nekro, support:hacan) and concealed ?n ids never reach the player. Real app against a mocked game; the before shots are the commit without the change.

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cd web && npm run screenshots -- GD. Before shots: copy this folder to a checkout of 80ce1bf1 and run with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before.

notes.title: One helper
notes.text: promissoryNoteMeta(id) in contentCatalog reads alias:faction, support:faction, a bare alias or ?n. humanizeNoteIds() applies it to prose (option labels, prompts, event log, toasts) through participantText; trade prompts keep the raw ids because the desk parses them.
